source_blocks.text: (UC San Diego)
09/2023 – Present
• Underwent practical training in nuclear facility operations and safety protocols, gaining exposure to real- time industrial systems and instrumentation
• Studied power generation, radiation safety, and control systems used in atomic energy production.
• Conducted research over two months and completed two papers on quantum machine learning and data integrity.
• Authored a review paper on Quantum Machine Learning Meets Anomaly Detection and a research paper on File Verification using Merkle Trees.
• Developed a CNN-based real-time system for hands-free media control using gesture recognition techniques.
• Achieved ~90% accuracy through model and preprocessing optimization, ensuring reliable real-time performance and smooth user experience.
• Built a multi-agent AI system to generate personalized travel      itineraries by analyzing user preferences, budget, duration, and trip constraints.
• Implemented agent orchestration with vector-based retrieval to deliver context-aware, accurate, and travel recommendations.
• Developed a rule-based chatbot for museum ticket booking, allowing users to view details, check availability, and generate booking confirmations.
• Implemented date validation, availability checks, booking reference generation, and integrated Razorpay for secure and seamless payments.
• Developed a full-stack e-commerce platform with product catalog, cart, and checkout features using the MERN stack.
• Built RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express.js and designed a responsive React frontend with dynamic routing, using MongoDB for data storage.
